title: sfo exchange: one line of directories.jsonl
description: One directory of a job with its verdict, as 'sfo export --format jsonl' writes it.

relative_path.description: Path relative to the job root, '/' as separator; '.' for the root.

scan_reason.description: Why the scan treated the folder as it did.

sensitive.description: Markers of the folder itself (a folder the scan skipped, such as .ssh).

text_withheld.description: True when a model text about the folder was replaced because it may name a marked file.

oneOf.description: A project, program, game or backup that only makes sense as a whole; never split up file by file.
A collection of similar content with one purpose, such as the photos of one trip or the invoices of one year.
Storage without a common purpose (desktop, downloads, misc); its files are handled one by one.
Contains no files, neither directly nor in subdirectories.
An operating system, tool or cache directory that is not user content.

A copy of a phone, a computer, a user profile or a removable drive. Recognised as a whole, but not a unit: its worth-keeping parts get verdicts of their own and are analysed, only its noise is skipped. Decided by a rule only; the model is never offered it.
Can be recreated or downloaded again (installers, caches, temporary files).
A deterministic rule decided without calling the model.
The model decided, or was asked and failed.
A person set the verdict by hand; it wins over rule and model. Since 1.2.
Passwords, password stores, login data, recovery codes, API keys or tokens, '.env' files.
Private keys, certificates with a private key, crypto wallets or seed phrases.

Personal messages between people who know each other: personal letters, chats and chat exports, private e-mails, mail archives and chat databases. Not a formal letter to or from a company, an authority or a landlord, a newsletter or an order confirmation.
Identity cards, passports, driving licences or scans of them.

Papers that show the money, income or debts of the person: bank and credit card statements, tax returns and tax certificates, payslips, depot and loan papers, card numbers. Not an ordinary invoice or receipt, a rental or other contract, or a table of amounts without account, income or debt.
Medical findings, doctor letters, health insurance documents.

rule.description: Id of the rule that decided; null when the model decided.

purpose.description: Purpose of the folder in one sentence.

unit_directory_id.description: For 'unit': the directory that is the whole.

escalated_from.description: The verdict before a sample raised the folder to 'mixed'.

profile.description: What the scan counted in the folder before it was judged: file count, bytes, extensions, file types, dates, name patterns, unit markers. Keys may be added.
